standard.summary: 开启后，Bucket 训练不会将小于目标分辨率的图像放大（超分），只缩小不放大。
standard.effect: 防止小图被放大训练（放大引入的模糊/噪声可能影响训练质量）。图像保持原始分辨率或缩小到匹配的桶。
standard.whenToUse: 数据集中包含低分辨率图像（如 256×256）时推荐开启，避免放大劣化图像质量。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据集全为高分辨率图像时无需开启（不会触发放大）。

standard_en.summary: Once on, bucket training never upscales an image below the target resolution -- it only shrinks.
standard_en.effect: Stops small images from being trained on upscaled (the blur and noise upscaling introduces can hurt training quality). Images keep their original resolution or shrink to the bucket that fits.
standard_en.whenToUse: Recommended when the dataset contains low-resolution images (256x256, say), so quality is not degraded by upscaling.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Not needed when every image in the dataset is already high resolution -- upscaling never triggers.

advanced.principle: 在桶分配时，若图像最大维度小于桶的最小维度，则不分配到该桶而是寻找面积更小的桶（或丢弃）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 可能导致小图被分配到更小的桶（更低分辨率训练），影响这部分数据的贡献度。

advanced_en.principle: During bucket assignment, if the image's largest dimension is smaller than the bucket's smallest dimension, the image is not assigned to that bucket — a smaller-area bucket is sought instead (or the image is dropped).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Small images may land in smaller buckets (lower-resolution training), reducing those images' contribution.
